text: In 2012, African football witnessed one of its most emotional triumphs when the Zambia national football team rose against all odds to win the 2012 Africa Cup of Nations.
Led by the calm and disciplined leadership of coach Hervé Renard, Zambia entered the tournament as underdogs.
Few believed they could compete with Africa’s giants. But match after match, the team played with unity, speed, and fearless determination.
